audits.method: Every unchanged final Filipino term and meaning read in full, compared against every Russian source field retained from the preceding complete paired-source draft audit; separate native-language editorial evaluation. All occurrences of repeated terminology and gender policy were read, without sampling.
audits.notes: Explicit family roles retain source sex disclosures; neutral siya/kanya/nito and professional nouns do not invent sex. Ordinary visitors versus capitalized threat Panauhin stay distinct. Item effects, uncertainty, scene timing, numbered personnel, codes and action results checked throughout.

audits.notes: Separate spirit concepts, cult/ordinary death distinction, plural groups, independent broadcast speakers, hearsay attribution, conditional endings, unknown biological sex, code replacement 451 to 955 and verified item/save behavior preserve source scope.

history: history/draft-v1-* preserves the complete first paired-entry draft audit with corrections. history/draft-v2-* preserves the partial 1-100 subsequent audit and additional family-role corrections. decisions.Guests: Capitalized Panauhin denotes the nonhuman threat; ordinary guests are bisita or lowercase panauhin when appropriate. Suspected symptoms never establish status.
decisions.agency: Komite sa mga Sitwasyong Pang-emerhensiya, contextually Komite, retains fictional identity; Russian КЧС and real МЧС comparison and official English FEMA remain exact source references.
decisions.gender: Filipino siya/kanya/nito are neutral. Known sexes and source-disclosed family roles remain explicit without premature disclosure. Unknown roles retain the complete owner-approved policy and participant/action attribution. Pusa remains biologically unknown despite original кот/он. Kamatayan retains Russian она evidence and poetic male sibling claim without bio assignment.
decisions.spirits: Espiritu ng Panauhin and Espiritu ng yumao remain separate attributed psychic concepts; neither is equated with threat Panauhin.
decisions.mushrooms: Lupain ng mga kabute, miselyo, Pista ng mga kabute, Tagapitas ng kabute and Aklat-aralin ng mga ngiti are consistent. Pahiwatig denotes hints without imposing riddles.
decisions.brands: Enerzheka, Bober Cherni and Margoro retain source brand identity; For Rest, AURACAM and CR Channel preserve exact spelling.
decisions.broadcasts: Every separate phone/radio/TV speaker or reference group remains separate, with identities and human/automation uncertainties preserved. Evening in TV For Rest uses Filipino gabi with exact original вечером contrasted to courier ночью because Filipino gabi covers both. No invented clock time.
decisions.mechanics: Exact sprite tags, energy units/durations, cigarette tradeoff, beer zero, consumable save persistence and distinct mushroom effects retained. Actions Ilabas ang baril/Magpaputok/Pakinggan/Pakawalan preserve distinct consequences. Home Opisina is distinguished from agency/medical premises.
